blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY—A remote monitoring station used to track activity at Kanlaon Volcano has resumed operations after vandals severed cables linking its equipment to solar panels, temporarily interrupting the transmission of monitoring data. The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) detected the disruption on Nov. 13 at its VKMH observation station in Sitio Manghumay, Barangay […]...
